narration: For {identical_months} months, the two lives were one life. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, the one that tracks how the days actually felt. The ghost's money reached its lowest point in month {ghost_lowest_month}. The layoff in month {layoff_month} found you both holding {layoff_real_net_worth}. By month {end_month}, the ghost's net worth was {net_worth_gap}.
